name: design-variant-picker
description: Interactive human-in-the-loop design variant picker for OpenCode. The agent shows HTML design variants in a browser grid; the user picks or asks for regenerations (produced by the same conversation's model) until satisfied.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin

author: plfavreau
